description: OPUS_5_TONE_REMINDER is the paired restatement the Opus 5 prompting guide recommends for long system prompts: the same instruction, repeated near the end so it is not buried under the skills catalog and rule blocks in between. It is 60 characters of prompt shipped on a stated assumption about position, and the assumption has never been measured. Running it as its own pack shows whether the reminder carries any effect on its own.

tasks.description: Identical task to opus5-response-length so the two blocks are directly comparable on one report.
